kernel.governing_law: The creative act performed without sanction produces a deformed, ignorant offspring; the mother, ashamed, hides it behind a barrier that becomes the visible world — exile is accomplished through a veil that names itself the only reality.
kernel.mutated_relation: The litter born without the pack's sanction is feral, stunted, and ravenous; the dam drives it from the den into territory that becomes its own kingdom — the border scent-mark hardens into the only ground the outcast can smell.

artifacts.enantiomorph:
But a whelp came out wrong with the runt of the litter. Something was dropped from the dam that was malformed and unlike the bloodline, and from the scent-map she carried, for she had produced him without the pack's mounting-rite. It bore no marking of her coat and it was spine-warped and hackle-bent, stunted at the shoulder, a runt gnawing its own birth-caul, suckled from her last teat, gorged on the marrow of a kill it never made.²⁵


The feral one was too busy scent-marking territory to sniff the trails left by older animals. The feral one was a creature that refused every track but its own.²⁶


When the dam saw what she had done, she dragged it by the scruff, beyond the den-mouth so that none of the elder litter would catch its scent. She drew a border-musk so thick nothing crosses across the place her work had fallen, creating a ridge between the high meadow and the gorge to split the upwind range from the downwind waste, burying the feral one in briar and loam, consigning him to the gully below the ridge, blocking the trail back to the denning ground, and called the veil the Musk Line.²⁷
